card.name: Patient-education page closing phrases
card.fires_on: Words in the closing lines of patient-education pages, such as 'more' in 'To learn more' or 'Find out more', and words in support-group advice. It also fires on scattered words in other health-information text.

modes.label: Learn more calls
modes.description: The word 'more' or 'To' in invitations to learn more at a health site.

modes.label: Support group advice
modes.description: Words in the sentence about joining a support group where members share experiences.
modes.example: You can ease the stress of illness by<< joining>> a support group where members share common experiences

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Single words in disclaimers, risk statements or institution names.
modes.example: Heart Center <<Disclaimer>> - This content is reviewed periodically and is

card.plain: It lights up on stock wording at the end of patient-information pages, like 'learn more' and support-group advice.
